# Driftly

Ship database changes without the 3am rollback

Driftly reviews every migration, runs it on a copy of production, and tells you what will lock.

## Features

### Shadow runs

See the real plan on real data before you ship.

### Lock detection

Know which statements would block writes.

### One-click rollback

Every change ships with its way back.

## Who it is for

Backend engineers.

## Pricing

Starts free. Team plans from $29 per month.
